meaning: Our research priorities inspired by public evidence, not assertions of anyone's private plans. No priority number is a probability.

hypotheses.title: Residual-bank compression under explicit hardware and quality budgets
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Low-error approximation with lower persistent storage at multiple depth/distribution settings, followed by matched-budget training and measured GPU memory.
hypotheses.falsifier: Rare-information loss, training regression, or dequantization/backward/communication costs erase the practical benefit.
hypotheses.next_gate: Real activation traces and matched token/time small-model training; no GPU spending authorized or performed.

hypotheses.title: Versioned context and durable agent completion contracts
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Replayable failures in explicitly defined baseline protocols; fixes survive additional fault schedules and then an actual harness adapter.
hypotheses.falsifier: Real harness does not exhibit the relevant failure, or protocol assumptions fail under torn writes, concurrent workers or external side effects.
hypotheses.next_gate: Integrate one public harness adapter and measure coverage/liveness, not just zero violation count in a narrow suite.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive evaluation bias in automated research
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Increasing public-feedback search budget inflates selected validation scores while sealed holdout fails to match.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent holdout matches selected gains after budget and multiple-comparison controls.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fixed candidate budget, one-shot hidden evaluation, multiple seeds; do not rebrand existing sealed evaluation as our invention.

hypotheses.title: Reward and environment-version consistency in agentic RL
hypotheses.supporting_observation: A versioned failure ledger exposes reward inconsistencies hidden by retries or final-success-only reporting.
hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated deterministic scoring and perturbation tests find no consequential inconsistencies.
hypotheses.next_gate: A small public environment with format, timeout and retry perturbations, plus independent final scoring.
